description: This Java class, BrowserControl, provides static methods to open a URL in the user's default web browser, handling different platforms (Windows and Unix) and fallback mechanisms if the Desktop API is not available.

classes.name: BrowserControl
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to open URLs in a web browser, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: displayURL
methods.description: Attempts to open the specified URL in the default web browser using Java Desktop API or fallback method.

methods.name: displayURLtraditional
methods.description: Fallback method that uses command line execution to open URL based on platform.

methods.name: isWindowsPlatform
methods.description: Checks the operating system to determine if the platform is Windows.
